title: The Eighth-Order Evolution Model for Closed Planar Curves
summary: We consider the $L^2(ds)$ gradient flow of $\frac12\int k_{ss}^2\,ds$ for smooth closed immersed planar curves. The stationary curves are precisely the multiply covered circles. We give an explicit sufficient condition under which the elastic energy is non-increasing and for each nonzero turning number, explicit small initial scale-invariant energy yields a global smooth solution with bounded positive length and exponential convergence to a fixed multiply covered circle, after reparametrisation.
